summary: UX/API review found 3 issues (all fixed): (1) 429 response missing Retry-After HTTP header per plan Phase 5 AC #4 — fixed by adding headers to NextResponse; (2) checkRateLimitByIp never created despite spec FR-4 and plan Phase 6 claiming [x] — added thin wrapper + export; (3) Phase 6 Task 1 [x] marker was untruthful (A5) — updated marker text to reflect actual delivery. All 34 rate-limit tests pass. tsc --noEmit clean.

nonblocking_findings.description: Login 429 response did not include Retry-After HTTP header. Plan Phase 5 specified it. The value was embedded in the message body only.

checkRateLimitByIp (spec FR-4, plan Phase 6) was never created. The spec required a per-IP-only check function. The shipped API folds IP into checkRateLimit(username, ip?) but no IP-only wrapper existed.
Plan Phase 6 Task 1 marked [x] but the parenthetical admitted checkRateLimitByIp was NOT exported. A5 false-claim.
